What a bookkeeping virtual assistant does each week

Define the records, reporting cycle, software access and finance reviewer before starting.

Daily and weekly records

Capture bills and receipts, record approved transactions and track missing documents. Review invoice exceptions with your finance owner.

Month-end and year-end preparation

Collect statements, prepare reconciliations and assemble draft reports. Track missing evidence in one checklist. Review store payouts and fees before close.

Work with your finance specialist

Organise source records for payroll, tax or controller review. Financial advice and final approval stay with your authorised specialist.

When this support helps

Set up a weekly invoice routine

Group new vendor bills by due date, match each to its supporting record and send the approval owner one list with exceptions.

Prepare for a monthly close

Compare the bank and card statements with the ledger. Show what matches and what needs review so the accountant can focus on the open items.

Recover a backlog

Select one period, test the proposed cleanup on a sample and record corrections before the finance owner approves work on older periods.

Planning your support

Explore the accounting and bookkeeping support topics that regularly matter to your team. These details explain how to prepare the work, review results and handle changes.

How a bookkeeping virtual assistant prepares a close pack

In this fictional example, a small retailer is closing the month.

Its marketplace deposit is lower than gross sales, one supplier bill has arrived twice, and a refund lands near the cutoff. Accounting and bookkeeping support turns those loose ends into a traceable review pack. The finance owner can see the evidence and decide how each open item should be treated.

  1. 01

    Collect one period of source records

    Start with the date range, statement totals, marketplace payout export, bill register and previous close checklist. A bookkeeping virtual assistant can link each source and note which export covers which dates. Keep the actual statements in the authorised workspace so a reviewer can check the original record.

  2. 02

    Match deposits, invoices and receipts

    Compare the deposit with the marketplace batch and show the sales, fees and refund entries that explain it. In the accounts payable and receivable registers, check for repeated invoice references and receipts without a match. Separate explained timing differences from items that still need the finance owner.

  3. 03

    Send a decision-ready pack

    Prepare the reconciliation worksheet, unpaid invoice and bill aging, and a list of questions with links to evidence. Accounting and bookkeeping support can also prepare draft reports from the approved ledger. Record the reviewer’s decisions and show which items remain open after the review.

When a task needs your decision

Record the source, what you checked and who can decide. Keep blocked work visible until the next action changes.

The payout total does not tie

Record the deposit date and batch, then compare fees, refunds and items outside the report range. A bookkeeping virtual assistant can show the unexplained balance and checks already performed. Put the evidence and open question in the reviewer’s queue before any correction is posted.

An invoice looks like a duplicate

Check the vendor, amount, currency and original invoice reference. Link the two records and keep the suspected duplicate visible in accounts payable and receivable until the authorised reviewer identifies the correct entry. Note if one copy is already scheduled or marked as paid.

A late item crosses the cutoff

Save the original dates and the supporting document. Accounting and bookkeeping support can flag which report or reconciliation is affected and ask whether to include it in the current close or the next one. Record the answer and the owner of any adjustment.

Set the rules for accounts payable and receivable

Ledger and main record

Give the bookkeeping virtual assistant the correct entity, period, accounts and chart of accounts. Provide one approved coding example and a list of transactions that must be left for the reviewer. Confirm where a corrected entry and its reason should be recorded.

Accounts payable and receivable rules

List who can draft a bill, issue an invoice, send an approved reminder or approve a payment. Share the matching rule for partial payments and examples of credit notes. Treat vendor bank detail changes as their own workflow with an authorised owner.

Close calendar and permissions

Set the document cutoff, review date and backup owner before accounting and bookkeeping support begins. Agree which tools allow draft edits, which are read-only and how to flag late documents. Make sure the first sample can be reviewed without sharing more access than it needs.

Review what your bookkeeping virtual assistant prepared

Trace a sample to the source

Pick a matched bank line, a customer receipt and a vendor bill. Check the amount, date, account, link and note against the original. Ask the bookkeeping virtual assistant to identify any coding rule that was unclear during the batch.

Check balances and next actions

Compare accounts payable and receivable totals with their source exports. Check which items are waiting on a vendor, a customer or finance. If the status changes the next follow-up date, make that date visible in the register.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you work in our existing accounting system?

We scope accounting and bookkeeping support around your ledger, source records, coding examples and permissions. Share a reviewer for the first sample.

Can a bookkeeping virtual assistant help with overdue invoices?

We can prepare aging lists, match incoming payments and draft or send approved reminders. Disputes, collections escalation and write-offs go to your finance owner.

What happens when a bank line does not match?

We record the amount, date, source and likely reason for the difference and send it for review. The reviewer decides whether an adjustment is needed.

Can you help prepare payroll?

We can collect approved hours and employee changes, check missing inputs and prepare a review pack. Your authorised payroll owner approves and submits the run.

Can you clean up older bookkeeping records?

Start with a small period and agree the correction rules. We document proposed changes and flag entries that need accounting judgment before a wider cleanup.

What do I receive at month-end?

Your accounting and bookkeeping support handoff can include reconciliation status, aging reports, draft ledger reports, source links and a list of decisions still open.
